## Batch 93 complete

Authored 15 draft items, both library pages, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch evidence, notes, and 15 current `ready` records. The A page uses composite-Simpson levels; its proofs establish mixed-detail decay, absolute reconstruction, actual node-union counts, and the dimension-dependent work/error bound. The B page contains all three planned examples.

The A-page source coverage includes the [Gerstner–Griebel sparse-grid chapter](https://ins.uni-bonn.de/media/public/publication-media/sparsegrids_j8NLaMi.pdf?name=sparsegrids.pdf) and [Zabaras lecture notes](https://web.ics.purdue.edu/~ibilion/www.zabaras.com/Courses/UQ/Smolyak.pdf). The B examples also draw on [Trefethen’s Clenshaw–Curtis paper](https://courses.grainger.illinois.edu/cs591mh/fa2012/trefethen/Clenshaw-Curtis.pdf) and [Gubner’s Gaussian quadrature paper](https://gubner.ece.wisc.edu/gaussquad.pdf). All seven coverage entries are fetch-verified.

Key artifacts: [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-linear-algebra-and-approximation/sparse-grid-cubature-and-mixed-regularity.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-linear-algebra-and-approximation/sparse-grid-cubature-and-mixed-regularity-examples.md), [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-93.notes.md), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-93.proof-contracts.json), and [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-93.coverage.json).

Scoped author checks, strict contracts, proof layout (15 items, 32 steps, zero defects), coverage validation, source fetching, manifest dependencies, and all 15 item-level dependency labels passed. Cross-batch reconciliation matched all 3 page edges and 11 item edges, with exact supplier excerpts.

## Run-wide blockers recorded

The global item-dependency check still reports eight empty manifests and stale labels on `ex-additive-eigensolve-tolerance-residual-certificate` and `ex-affine-random-diffusion-uniform-coercivity`. Batch-dependency recomputation is blocked by duplicate YAML `locator` keys in two unrelated batch-90 item files. I left those files and shared artifacts unchanged. The dispatch digest (`a20c83…`) also differs from the shared dependency artifact digest (`04a57e…`), though both show batch 93 at level 6 with prerequisites 20, 43, and 82.

The notes record the plan wording ambiguity about external canonical premises and the interpretation used. No test suites were run. The readiness records indicate authoring completeness, not independent approval.
